title: Rollup
description: A module bundler optimized for ES6 modules and libraries.

data.text: Rollup is a module bundler that focuses on ES6 module syntax and produces efficient bundles through tree-shaking. It is the bundler of choice for libraries, producing smaller output than application bundlers.

data.title: Rollup Configuration
data.content: Build a library bundle with Rollup.

terms.definition: Eliminating unused code during the bundling process for smaller output.
ECMAScript Modules — the standard module system for JavaScript in browsers and Node.js.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Rollup excels at building libraries with tree-shaking
Outputs ESM, CJS, and UMD formats
Used by many popular libraries including React
data.takeaway: Rollup is the gold standard for bundling JavaScript libraries.
